title: Structural alterations as a predictor of depression - a 7-Tesla MRI-based multidimensional approach.
summary: Leave-one-out cross-validation on 41 patients and 41 controls plus permutation analysis identified MRI regions associated with classification; no external cohort was tested. The finding is bounded to the reported study and does not establish causal benefit or generalization.
